entities.summary: The Temple of Juno Lacinia is a ruined ancient Greek temple at the heart of a sanctuary dedicated to Hera located on Capo Colonna in Calabria, Italy, near Crotone. The main remaining feature is a Doric column with capital, about 27 feet (8.2 m) in height.
